properties.title: ReliefWeb reporting on Myanmar: 16 reports in 7 days
properties.summary: ReliefWeb posted 16 reports in the last 7 days, against an average of 7.58 per week over the 12 weeks before, with Myanmar as the main country of the report. Unusual (RL-IND-4): at that average, the chance of 16 or more in a week is 0.5%, below the 1% threshold. A count of reports measures reporting attention, not need.

properties.title: DREF: Afghanistan - Drought
properties.summary: IFRC launched a DREF allocation for Afghanistan (Drought) on 23 Nov 2026. CHF 21,159 requested, CHF 21,159 funded (100%), 2,560 people targeted. Active; IFRC lists the end date as 31 Jan 2027. Afghanistan has had 1 IFRC appeal start in the last 90 days, against an average of 0.46 per 90 days over 2016-11-24 to 2026-08-25.
